name: Collateral Proposal
definition: Specifies collateral proposed to the counterparty.

ResponseType.name: Response Type
ResponseType.definition: Indicates whether the collateral proposal is an initial or a counter proposal.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Indicates whether this is an initial or counter proposal.

ProposedCollateralMovement.name: Proposed Collateral Movement
ProposedCollateralMovement.definition: Details the movement of collateral that is proposed to be delivered or returned by one of the collateral parties.

RelatedManagementProcess.name: Related Management Process
RelatedManagementProcess.definition: Process which groups the activities related to collateral.
